name: Molly menu
description: Molly's application menu, kept short: the start page, the apps, this app, settings and account at the top; everything else in sub-menus (spec: apps/molly/menus/inventory.md).
author: AmberX AXF

items.label: Start page
items.hint: Molly's start page: every app with Open in Molly and Open on its own.

items.label: Apps
items.hint: Switch to another app. Each one stays alive in the background.

items.label: Console
items.hint: The Dev Console: builds, plugins, UI Review.

items.label: Expenses
items.hint: The Expense Tracker: ledger, paydays, reports.

items.label: This app
items.hint: Commands for the app on screen.

items.label: Reload this app
items.hint: Reload only the app on screen; the others keep their place.

items.label: Open this app on its own
items.hint: Open the app on screen at its own address in a new tab.

items.label: Settings
items.hint: All of Molly's settings: appearance, plugins, account.

items.label: Account
items.hint: Who you're signed in as, and your roles.
